Usage of <binary>:
  -benchmark
    	Benchmark scan and print throughput to stdout
  -csv-columns string
    	Comma-separated CSV/TSV column names (default: all columns)
  -dup-mode string
    	Duplicate detection mode: first10mb, sample, full, smart (default "smart")
  -external string
    	External drive directory for move action
  -format string
    	Export format: json, csv, tsv, yaml, md, html, txt (default: json; auto-detected from -out extension when not specified) (default "json")
  -ignore-hidden
    	Ignore hidden files and directories
  -json
    	Export scan results to stdout (non-interactive)
  -out string
    	Export scan results to the specified file (implies non-interactive)
  -paths string
    	Comma-separated paths to scan (default: ~)
  -progress-interval int
    	Report analyzer progress every N files (default 100)
  -stdout
    	Export scan results to stdout (works with any -format; alias for -json)
  -tui-style string
    	Interactive TUI style: terminal or dua (default "dua")
  -version
    	Show version
